steps.name: When I send a POST to "/auth/firebase/apply-action-code" with raw body "{invalid json"
Then the response status should be 400

expected 400; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-11-10T09:27:04.272","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"The request body contains invalid JSON. Please check your syntax","path":"/api/auth/firebase/apply-action-code","requestId":"REQ-15ba6437"}
And the error message should contain "invalid JSON"
error body must carry the contract message
When I send a POST to "/auth/firebase/confirm-password-reset" with raw body "not json"
Then the response status should be 400

expected 400; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-11-10T09:27:04.282","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"The request body contains invalid JSON. Please check your syntax","path":"/api/auth/firebase/confirm-password-reset","requestId":"REQ-f5406992"}
And the error message should contain "invalid JSON"
error body must carry the contract message
